_help: Auto-skip rules for the weekly check. Times are JST (this PC). A lesson matching a rule is still LISTED in the weekly check, marked auto-skipped, and you can override it. weekdays: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun (omit = any day). from_hour/to_hour are 0-23 on the lesson START time (to_hour omit = until midnight). match = optional text that must appear in the filename.
_skip_help: skip_students: first word of the student's lesson label (from the YouTube title) - these are never clipped, even if listed. Edit freely.
